_comment: Shared fixture for the relay age-composition rule, implemented independently in TS (shared-ui/src/logic/relayRules.ts, used by meet-app and RelayEntryPage.tsx) and Python (team-app/backend/app/routers/api.py: _age_code_allowed_on_team / _would_miss_native_anchor). Both implementations' test suites iterate this file so drift becomes a test failure. order matches Python's fixed _AGE_CODE_ORDER — the TS functions take an order array as a parameter (built per-meet at the call site), but these cases stick to the canonical bracket codes so both languages test the same inputs.

isAgeCodeAllowedOnTeam.note: code not in order never blocks
native code not in order never blocks
adjacent-younger at the top of the order
older candidate on younger team, never allowed

wouldMissNativeAnchor.note: native candidate, plenty of room left
swim-up candidate, still 2 slots that could be native
last slot, zero native members total
last slot, only 1 native member total (need 2)
last slot, exactly 2 native members total
1 native so far, 1 slot left that could still make it 2
